name: Spectroscopy (1D, 2D, IFU cubes)
description: Link spectra (1D tables / images, 2D spectra, IFU cubes) to catalog objects, extract them, fit emission lines with Gaussians, find redshifts from the lines and look at the spectra in a viewer window. The science step adds air/vacuum and Milky Way corrections, absorption lines, a Gaussian dispersion, a spectral type, and an H-alpha star-formation rate. The supernova step types H, He, Si, and O at one photospheric velocity and needs a host redshift.

params.name: spec-dir
params.label: Spectrum directory
params.help: Directory with the spectra (FITS table / 1D image / ASCII, 2D spectra, IFU cubes).

params.name: spec-pattern
params.label: File name pattern
params.help: {NUMBER} is replaced by the catalog NUMBER.

params.name: link-file
params.label: Link table (NUMBER FILE [KIND X Y ROW])
params.help: Optional TSV that overrides the pattern: one line per object; FILE relative to the table (or the spectrum directory).

params.name: kind
params.label: File kind
params.help: auto = detect (table / 1D image -> 1D, 2D image -> 2D spectrum, 3D -> IFU cube).

params.name: wave-unit
params.label: Wavelength unit
params.help: auto = from the file (CUNIT/TUNIT; micron-sized values without unit are read as micron).

params.name: row-column
params.label: Catalog column with the spectrum row
params.help: 2D spectra: row (0-based) of the object; empty = the middle row. A ROW column in the link table has priority.

params.name: extract-mode
params.label: 2D extraction
params.help: boxcar = fractional-edge sum; optimal = Horne weights with a Gaussian profile measured from the collapsed spectrum.

params.name: sky-inner
params.label: Sky rows: inner offset
params.help: Rows with inner < |row - object| <= outer give a median sky per column that is subtracted (outer 0 = off).

params.name: aperture-radius
params.label: IFU aperture radius (spaxels)
params.help: Circular aperture centred on the catalog X_IMAGE / Y_IMAGE read as spaxel coordinates (or X, Y of the link table).

params.name: cube-xy
params.label: Catalog position = spaxel
params.help: If off, cubes are extracted at the cube centre unless the link table gives X, Y.

params.name: snr-min
params.label: Line detection S/N
params.help: Matched-filter threshold.

params.name: cont-width
params.label: Continuum window (pixels)
params.help: Width of the running median (lines masked iteratively).

params.name: z-column
params.label: Known redshift column (empty = blind)
params.help: If the catalog has a redshift (e.g. Z_SPEC), lines are fitted at that redshift instead of searching.

params.name: fit-line
params.label: Line for SP_LINE_* columns
params.help: Flux, FWHM and rest-frame equivalent width of this line are reported.

params.name: wave-frame
params.label: Wavelength frame
params.help: Air wavelengths are converted to vacuum with the SDSS/Morton formula before the lines are matched.

params.name: ebv-mw
params.label: Milky Way E(B-V)
params.help: Cardelli, Clayton & Mathis 1989, Rv=3.1. 0 leaves the flux unchanged.

params.name: inst-fwhm
params.label: Instrumental FWHM (A)
params.help: Removed in quadrature from the Gaussian line width. 0 reports the observed width and leaves the corrected dispersion empty.

params.name: h0
params.label: H0 (km/s/Mpc)
params.help: Flat Lambda-CDM Hubble constant used for the H-alpha star-formation rate.

params.name: omega-m
params.label: Omega_m
params.help: Matter density of the same cosmology.

params.name: kin-line
params.label: Kinematics line
params.help: Emission line whose centroid / width gives v and sigma (2D spectra and IFU cubes).

params.name: kin-z
params.label: Redshift for kinematics
params.help: 0 = use the z column, else the blind redshift of the extracted 1D spectrum. Sets the systemic wavelength.

params.name: kin-window-kms
params.label: Line window (+- km/s)
params.help: Half width of the fitting window around the systemic line; neighbouring lines (e.g. [NII] next to Ha at +-700 km/s) must stay outside, so keep it below their offset.

params.name: kin-snr-pix
params.label: Min S/N per spaxel / row
params.help: Matched-filter line S/N below which a spaxel (cube) or row (2D, when no binning) is not fitted.

params.name: kin-bin-snr
params.label: Target S/N of a bin
params.help: >0: adjacent rows (2D) / spaxels (cube) are accreted until the bin reaches this S/N (0 = fit every spaxel / row on its own).

params.name: kin-inst-fwhm
params.label: Instrumental FWHM (A)
params.help: Removed in quadrature from the fitted line width to give the intrinsic dispersion (0 = none).

params.name: kin-inc
params.label: Inclination (deg, 0 = fit)
params.help: Fixed inclination (e.g. from the image axis ratio): deprojects the rotation curve (2D) and removes the v_c - inclination degeneracy (cube).

params.name: kin-slit-psi
params.label: Slit offset from major axis (deg)
params.help: 2D spectra: angle between the slit and the kinematic major axis (observed v_c is reduced by cos psi).

steps.label: Measure redshift, type, dispersion, SFR
steps.title: Preprocess, fit emission and absorption lines, and report dispersion, type, redshift and H-alpha SFR

steps.label: Supernova type
steps.title: Type a supernova from H, He, Si, and O at one photospheric velocity. The known-redshift column is required; line velocities are not a redshift.

steps.label: Fit Kinematics (2D slit / IFU cube)
steps.title: Emission-line kinematics (rotation curve, velocity and dispersion maps)
